# cozystack_backup_plan (Resource)

A Cozystack backup Plan: a schedule that backs up a tenant application using a BackupClass strategy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cozystack_backup_plan" "daily" {
  name              = "daily"
  namespace         = "tenant-root"
  backup_class_name = "s3-daily"

  application_ref = {
    api_group = "apps.cozystack.io"
    kind      = "Postgres"
    name      = "app"
  }

  schedule = {
    cron = "0 3 * * *"
    type = "Cron"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_ref` (Attributes) Application to back up. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--application_ref))
- `backup_class_name` (String) BackupClass that provides the backup strategy.
- `name` (String) Plan name (`metadata.name`). Immutable.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace the application is created in. Immutable.
- `schedule` (Attributes) When backup copies are created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))

### Optional

- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Block on create/update until the tenant's `Ready` condition is true.
- `wait_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait when `wait_for_ready` is set (Go duration, e.g. `10m`).

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version (`status.version`).
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier in the form `namespace/name`.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`). Stable across updates; changes on recreate.
